title: King of Thorn — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about King of Thorn. King of Thorn (Japanese: いばらの王, Hepburn: Ibara no Ō) is a Japanese fantastique manga series written and illustrated by Yuji Iwahara. It was published by Enterbrain in the seinen magazine Monthly Comic Beam between October 2002 and October 2005 and collected in six bound volumes.

The story King of Thorn tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. He was the first to witness Peter's revived, insect-filled Medusa form, at whose sight he became frightened and ran away, struggling by himself against the perils of the ruined facility. He almost drowned when Marco, oblivious of Ron's presence, drained the facility's main shaft from a massive flood, and later reunited himself with Kasumi, Tim and Katherine.
